clips.title: The story
paras: In Felwood, tainted ooze is gathered from the remains of corrupted oozes. The samples travel in containment jars to Ironforge, where they support bold theories about life’s origins on Azeroth.

Across northern Kalimdor, tainted oozes carry Felwood’s lingering corruption. Gnomish researchers provide jars to contain them safely. Most travelers keep clear of the noxious creatures, but their remains yield samples for natural philosophy and biological study far from the blighted woods.

Laris Geardawdle, a gnome scholar with the Explorers' League in Ironforge, gathers the samples. He is fascinated by how common slimes are, and has noticed the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society taking an interest in them as well. Many scholars dismiss his theory, but Geardawdle believes slimes and oozes may be primal secretions tied to Azeroth's creation. He seeks proof and a place among dwarven scholars after Gnomeregan's tragic fall.
